Destinations / Rishikesh & Garhwal

Rishikesh & Garhwal

Ganga river camps, yoga and Himalayan foothills

Best time: September – November, February – May. Riverside beaches and gentle rafting for kids 12+. Short drive from Delhi.

Highlights

  • Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat
  • White-water rafting
  • Chopta meadows and Tungnath
  • Rajaji National Park

Suggested road trips

Delhi → Rishikesh → Chopta

5 days · about 520 km. River camps, then up into rhododendron forests for the Tungnath trek.

  1. Delhi → Rishikesh (240 km, about 6 h)
  2. Rishikesh → Shivpuri (rafting) (30 km, about 1 h)
  3. Rishikesh → Rudraprayag (140 km, about 5 h): Along the Alaknanda; Devprayag confluence on the way.
  4. Rudraprayag → Chopta (75 km, about 3 h): Hairpin bends through forest.
  5. Chopta → Rudraprayag (75 km, about 3 h): Morning Tungnath trek, then down.

Rishikesh weekend

2 days · about 60 km. Rafting at Shivpuri and a night on a river beach.

Before you go

Rishikesh is low (about 370 m); Chopta is about 2,700 m, with cold nights.

Fill up at Rudraprayag or Ukhimath before Chopta.

Highway widening in progress on the Char Dham routes; landslides are common in the monsoon (July–September). Drive in daylight.
